text: Free heist demo where your crew is also your competition.
Rob the mall, then steal your friends' loot right out of their hands.
Trigger fire alarms, tase your rivals, and race to the getaway van before the cops arrive.
Until you extract, nothing you stole is really yours.
Best part: you can push a whole shopping cart of loot to the van.
The catch? Right now it looks early. The mall is empty and the guards barely react.
Four players by default, up to twelve, and the full game is due November second.
Think Payday, but everyone's a traitor.
Worth a dip with friends you'd happily betray.
